description: This file defines a React component 'FileDragNDropProvider' that manages drag-and-drop file upload functionality, including context setup, event handling, overlay display, and integration with application controllers.

classes.name: FileDragTargetData
classes.description: Type defining data for a drag target, including tooltip text and callback function.

classes.name: FileDnDContextData
classes.description: Type defining the context data for drag-and-drop, including dragging state and target management functions.

methods.name: addOverlayToElement
methods.description: Sets overlay dimensions and position to match a target element.

methods.name: addDragTarget
methods.description: Registers a drag target element with associated data.

methods.name: removeDragTarget
methods.description: Removes a registered drag target element.
